targets.query:
from(bucket: "local_system")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "uptime_sec")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "local_system")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_usage")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.task == "TOTAL_CPU0")

from(bucket: "local_system")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_usage")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.task == "TOTAL_CPU1")

from(bucket: "local_system")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "cpu" and
      r._field == "usage_active"
  )
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "local_system")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_usage")

from(bucket: "local_system")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.task == "TOTAL_CPU1")

from(bucket: "local_system")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "power_system")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "voltage_mv")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "local_system")

  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "local_system")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_usage")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "usage")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.task != "TOTAL_CPU0")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.task != "TOTAL_CPU1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.task =~ /cpu0/ or r.task == "IDLE0" or r.task == "main"
    or r.task =~ /rtcontrol/ or r.task == "tiT"
    or r.task =~ /emac/ or r.task =~ /esp_timer/
    or r.task =~ /calib/ or r.task =~ /ipc0/)
  |> group(columns: ["task"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, task: r.task, display: r.task}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "task", "display"])

from(bucket: "local_system")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_usage")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "usage")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.task != "TOTAL_CPU0")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.task != "TOTAL_CPU1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.task =~ /cpu1/ or r.task == "IDLE1"
    or r.task =~ /comms/ or r.task =~ /monitor/
    or r.task =~ /uros/ or r.task =~ /mqtt/
    or r.task =~ /ptp/ or r.task =~ /tel_/
    or r.task =~ /ipc1/)
  |> group(columns: ["task"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, task: r.task, display: r.task}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "task", "display"])

from(bucket: "local_system")

from(bucket: "local_system")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "net")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["interface"] == "eth0" or r["interface"] == "wlan0")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "bytes_recv" or r["_field"] == "bytes_sent")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: (r._value * 8.0) / 1000000.0 }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.interface + "_" + r._field }))
  |> yield(name: "velocidad_mbps")

  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))
